using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Poly.Generated;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Services.ConfigureHttpJsonOptions(options => {
    options.SerializerOptions.ReferenceHandler = ReferenceHandler.IgnoreCycles;
    options.SerializerOptions.Converters.Add(new JsonStringEnumConverter());
});

builder.Services.AddDbContext<TDbCtx>(options => options.UseInMemoryDatabase("T"));

var app = builder.Build();

using (var scope = app.Services.CreateScope())
{
    var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<TDbCtx>();
    await SeedAsync(db);
}

app.MapGet("/api/orders", async (TDbCtx db) => await db.Orders.ToListAsync());

app.MapGet("/api/orders/{id}", async (int id, TDbCtx db) => (await db.Orders.FindAsync(id) is Order order ? Results.Ok(order) : Results.NotFound()));

app.MapPost("/api/orders", async (OrderDto dto, TDbCtx db) => {
    var orderResult = Order.Create(Enumerable.Empty<OrderLine>());
    if (!orderResult.IsSuccess)
    {
        return FailureStatus(orderResult.ErrorMessage);
    }
    db.Orders.Add(orderResult.Value);
    await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    return Results.Ok(orderResult.Value);
});

app.MapGet("/api/orders/{id}/lines", async (int id, TDbCtx db) => {
    var parent = await db.Orders.FindAsync(id);
    if (parent == null)
    {
        return Results.NotFound();
    }
    await db.Entry(parent).Collection(e => e.Lines).LoadAsync();
    return Results.Ok(parent.Lines);
});

app.MapGet("/api/orders/{id}/lines/{orderLineId}", async (int id, int orderLineId, TDbCtx db) => {
    var parent = await db.Orders.FindAsync(id);
    if (parent == null)
    {
        return Results.NotFound();
    }
    await db.Entry(parent).Collection(e => e.Lines).LoadAsync();
    var child = await db.OrderLines.FindAsync(orderLineId);
    if (child == null || !parent.Lines.Any(e => e == child))
    {
        return Results.NotFound();
    }
    return Results.Ok(child);
});

app.MapPost("/api/orders/{id}/addline", async (int id, AddLineDto dto, TDbCtx db) => {
    var entity = await db.Orders.FindAsync(id);
    if (entity == null)
    {
        return Results.NotFound("Order not found");
    }
    await db.Entry(entity).Collection(e => e.Lines).LoadAsync();
    try
    {
        var result = entity.AddLine(dto.Q);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        if (result.IsSuccess)
        {
            return Results.Ok("ok");
        }
        else
        {
            return FailureStatus(result.ErrorMessage);
        }
    }
    catch (Exception)
    {
        return Results.StatusCode(500);
    }
});

static IResult FailureStatus(string? message)
{
    return (message != null && (message.Contains("Unique constraint") || message.Contains("already has a target")) ? Results.Conflict(message) : Results.BadRequest(message));
}


static async System.Threading.Tasks.Task SeedAsync(TDbCtx db)
{
    if (db == null)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (await db.Orders.AnyAsync())
    {
        return;
    }
    var orderResult = Order.Create(Enumerable.Empty<OrderLine>());
    if (orderResult.IsSuccess)
    {
        db.Add(orderResult.Value);
    }
    await db.SaveChangesAsync();
}


app.Run();


public record AddLineDto
{
    [Range(10, 20)]
    public long Q { get; init; }
}
